facebook.caption: POV: your first night in Phu Quoc and you have no plan. Walk to Đường Trần Hưng Đạo. Follow the smoke. The Chợ đêm Phú Quốc night market pulls you in before you even decide to go. Grilled seafood, local noodles, cold beer. 385 people rated this 4.2 stars and most of them weren't even trying to find it. Let the smell do the navigation. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Smoke rising, stalls packed, nowhere to be. This is Chợ đêm Phú Quốc on a regular Tuesday. Grab a stool, point at something grilling, and just eat. No reservation needed.
